name: atria
description: Atria creative intelligence for AI coding agents: search the ad library, read competitors, analyze your own ad accounts, and go from finding to concept to brief to finished copy with skills that share one workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Ad library, competitor tracking, and ad-account analysis
interface.longDescription: Search Atria's ad library, track competitor advertisers, and analyze performance for connected Facebook and TikTok ad accounts. Bundled skills cover the weekly account report, competitor teardowns and swipe files; the Skill Hub loads everything else Atria publishes.
defaultPrompt: Weekly report for my ad account: last complete week versus the week before
Tear down what my top competitor is running right now
Build a swipe file of UGC testimonial ads in my category
